name: Speridlabs Iris-Z
paper_title: Iris-Z: Scaling One Generative Model Past Specialist Geometry Models
license_interpretation: The Iris-Z SDK code is Apache-2.0, and LibreYOLO's port of its transformer, samplers and prompt embedders keeps that license, with notices in libreyolo/models/gen/speridlabs_irisz/NOTICE; LibreYOLO's adapter is MIT. The Iris-Z weights are a fine-tune of FLUX.2 and are published by Speridlabs at speridlabs/iris-z under the FLUX Non-Commercial License: they may be used for non-commercial purposes, and section 2(e) asks for generated images to be filtered or reviewed before they are shared. LibreYOLO does not redistribute them; they download from speridlabs/iris-z at a pinned revision. The FLUX.2 VAE downloads from black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-4B and the Mistral Small 3.2 and Qwen3 8B text encoders from their publishers, all Apache-2.0. Nothing is gated.
